Problem Statement
Read a product code. Print it in capital letters, its length, its first character and its last character. 
Description
Every product in a store has a code, such as bolt-45a. For the label, the code must be printed in capital letters. Read the code and print four things: the code in capital letters, the number of characters in the code, the first character of the code, and the last character of the code. The first and last characters are printed as they were typed. 
Input Description
A single line with the product code. It has letters, digits and the - sign, and has no spaces. (1 to 20 characters) 
Output Description
Print four lines: the code in capital letters, the length of the code, the first character, and the last character. 
Sample Input
bolt-45a 
Sample Output
BOLT-45A
8
b
a
